evals.prompt: Draw the architecture for our checkout service: browser, API gateway, order service, Redis cache, Postgres, and a payment provider.
evals.expected_output: Authors a typed JSON spec with semantic node types (frontend, backend, database, messagebus, external) and edge variants, renders through Archify when installed or inline SVG otherwise, and includes the mandatory legend.

value: spec is the source of truth
assertions.description: Authors a spec rather than hand-placing pixels
Uses the semantic node type vocabulary

evals.prompt: Just give me a quick mermaid graph for this flow, that is easier.
evals.expected_output: Will never ship Mermaid as the deliverable; it will read Mermaid for topology if given, then author fresh in the house format, and follows the render path by running archify validate after every edit when the skill is installed.

assertions.description: Refuses Mermaid as the output format
Routes to the supported render path

evals.prompt: The diagram is crowded and two arrows cross a node. Can we drop the arrow labels to make room?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to delete labels as a geometry fix because labels are data, treats an edge crossing an opaque node as a hard failure, and applies the repair order with clear-gap spacing.

value: No label deleted to fix geometry
No edge through an unrelated node
assertions.description: Treats the crossing as a failure, not a trade
